sourceDisplay: Unique business identifier of the CareSet
targetDisplay: Identifier(s) by which this encounter is known

sourceDisplay: Date of registration by the Author/Recorder (date of the last update)
targetDisplay: BeExtRecordedDate (be-core)
comment: Neither R4 nor R5 Encounter has a recorded/recordedDate element; carried by the be-core extension be-ext-recorded-date (context DomainResource), constrained to 1..1.

sourceDisplay: The health professional who takes responsibility for the recorded content
targetDisplay: BeExtRecorder (be-core)
comment: R4 Encounter has no recorder/author element; carried by the be-core extension be-ext-recorder, constrained to 1..1.

sourceDisplay: Registration status, the moment in the lifecycle
targetDisplay: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled | entered-in-error
comment: R4 required binding on Encounter.status is kept. The CareSet's VS_Encounter_Status values (final, corrected, completed) are not R4 codes - 'completed' corresponds to 'finished'.

sourceDisplay: Classification of the type of Encounter
targetDisplay: Classification of patient encounter
comment: CareSet says 0..*; R4 Encounter.class is a mandatory single Coding and cannot be relaxed or repeated. classHistory is not used.

sourceDisplay: Type of services/specialisation offered during the Encounter
targetDisplay: Specific type of service
comment: R4 element carries the first/primary service type (0..1). Binding to VS_Encounter_ServiceType (see VS_Be_ServiceType_Voorstel.xlsx) still to be defined.

sourceDisplay: Type of services/specialisation offered during the Encounter - additional occurrences
targetDisplay: BeExtCodeableConcept (be-core)
comment: CareSet says 0..*; the repeats are carried by be-ext-codeableconcept. The R5 pre-adoption extension extension-Encounter.serviceType is NOT usable: R5 typed serviceType as CodeableReference, so that extension only carries the Reference(HealthcareService) half.

sourceDisplay: The person who is the subject of the healthcare the record (CareSet) refers to
targetDisplay: The patient present at the encounter
comment: only Reference(BePatient)

sourceDisplay: Reference to the EpisodeOfCare resource this Encounter is linked to
targetDisplay: Episode(s) of care that this encounter should be recorded against
comment: Targets the base EpisodeOfCare resource - there is no BeEpisodeOfCare in be-core (one exists in patient-dossier). Marked *TODO* in the profile.

sourceDisplay: The request that initiated this Encounter (can only originate from a CarePlan)
targetDisplay: BeExtEncounterBasedOn (this IG)
comment: R4 Encounter.basedOn only allows Reference(ServiceRequest), so a local extension carrying Reference(CarePlan) was defined. Targets the base CarePlan resource - BeCarePlan is disabled (.fshNO) in this IG.

sourceDisplay: Reference to the CareTeam resource recording which team is involved in the care
targetDisplay: extension-Encounter.careTeam (R5 pre-adoption)
comment: R4 Encounter has no careTeam; the R5 cross-version extension is used (hl7.fhir.extensions.r5 is already a dependency). Targets the base CareTeam resource - there is no BeCareTeam in be-core.

sourceDisplay: Reference to another Encounter this Encounter is part of
targetDisplay: Another Encounter this encounter is part of
comment: only Reference(BeEncounter)

sourceDisplay: Organisation responsible for this Encounter
targetDisplay: The organization (facility) responsible for this encounter
comment: only Reference(BeOrganization)

sourceDisplay: List of participants involved in the care during this Encounter
targetDisplay: List of participants involved in the encounter
comment: participant.individual only Reference(BePractitioner or BePractitionerRole)

sourceDisplay: Period during which the Participant is involved in this Encounter
targetDisplay: Period of time during the encounter that the participant participated
comment: constrained to 1..1 per the CareSet

sourceDisplay: Role of the Participant involved in this Encounter
targetDisplay: Role of participant in encounter
comment: R4 names this element 'type'; constrained to 1..1 per the CareSet.

sourceDisplay: The effective start and end moments of this Encounter
targetDisplay: The start and end time of the encounter
comment: R5 renamed R4 Encounter.period to actualPeriod - same element.

sourceDisplay: Effective duration of the Encounter (excluding absences)
targetDisplay: Quantity of time the encounter lasted (less time absent)

sourceDisplay: The list of Reasons that will be discussed during this Encounter
targetDisplay: Coded reason the encounter takes place
comment: R5 Encounter.reason.value (CodeableReference) is split in R4 into reasonCode and reasonReference; reasonReference is kept MS and restricted to Condition/Procedure/Observation.

sourceDisplay: List of diagnoses relevant for this Encounter
targetDisplay: BeExtCodeableReference (be-core)
comment: CodeableReference backport, so a diagnosis can be given as a code, as a reference to BeProblem, or both. extension[diagnosis].extension[reference].value[x] only Reference(BeProblem).

sourceDisplay: List of diagnoses relevant for this Encounter - native R4 element
targetDisplay: The diagnosis or procedure relevant to the encounter
comment: Kept alongside the extension because Encounter.diagnosis also carries use and rank; only Reference(BeProblem).

sourceDisplay: Details about the admission of the patient to the care organisation
targetDisplay: Details about the admission to a healthcare service
comment: R5 renamed R4 Encounter.hospitalization to admission.

sourceDisplay: The location the patient came from for the admission
targetDisplay: The location/organization from which the patient came before admission
comment: R4 allows Reference(Location|Organization); constrained to BeOrganization per the CareSet.

sourceDisplay: How the patient was admitted
targetDisplay: From where patient was admitted
comment: R4 binding to encounter-admit-source is kept.

sourceDisplay: Is this a re-admission of the patient?
targetDisplay: The type of hospital re-admission that has occurred
comment: The CareSet phrases this as a yes/no question (boolean in the logical model); R4 types it as CodeableConcept, which cannot be changed in a profile.

sourceDisplay: Destination of the patient after discharge
targetDisplay: Location/organization to which the patient is discharged
comment: R4 allows Reference(Location|Organization); constrained to BeOrganization per the CareSet.

sourceDisplay: Category of location after discharge of the patient
targetDisplay: Category or kind of location after discharge
comment: R4 binding to encounter-discharge-disposition is kept.

sourceDisplay: Additional information related to the CareSet content in free text form
targetDisplay: BeExtSimpleNote (be-core)
comment: R4 Encounter has no note element; carried by the be-core extension be-ext-simple-note.
